iti56:1.1: (Tik. I.) Vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttam-arahatā ti me sutaṃ.
iti56:2.1: Tayo me bhikkhave āsavā. Katame tayo? Kāmāsavo bhavāsavo avijjāsavo, ime kho bhikkhave tayo āsavā ti. Etam-atthaṃ bhagavā avoca, tatthetaṃ iti vuccati:
iti56:3.1: Samāhito sampajāno sato buddhassa sāvako | āsave ca pajānāti āsavānañca sambhavaṃ ||
iti56:4.1: yattha cetā nirujjhanti maggañca khayagāminaṃ | āsavānaṃ khayā bhikkhu nicchāto parinibbuto ti ||
iti56:5.1: Ayam-pi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan-ti ||7|| (Tik.
